Credits, provenance, and licensing

The 3n + 1 problem

Pick a positive integer. If it’s even, halve it. If it’s odd, multiply by three and add one. Keep going.

Does every starting number reach 1?
That’s still an open question.

Browser game · 2026

Sundrift

Drift through a mountain pass and neon city in a browser-based driving game with procedurally generated roads and terrain. Each drift brings the sunrise a little closer.

  • Three.js rendering and procedural terrain
  • Keyboard and touch input
  • Synthesized audio
